rules: Default routes change only through an owner decision recorded in the task (owner_decision: true).

A performance verdict needs a preregistered protocol committed before the first timed run, an isolated host (load <= 8 before and after, arm spread <= 10%) and achieved-error matching; shared-host numbers are diagnostic.
Keep research/LEDGER.jsonl append-only; add rows only with the script named in docs/agent/switcher_v2_remediation/DESIGN.md section 13.2.
Use a fresh CARGO_TARGET_DIR per worktree; a shared target directory across source revisions produced stale artifacts in this run (unresolved imports after a baseline clippy).
Never force-push; never merge to main; push research branches only.

tasks.title: Reproduce this run on the pinned toolchain and the owner host
tasks.question: Do the 577/0/1 facade result, the stage-client suites and the diagnostic two-way ratios reproduce on Rust 1.94.1 and a Ryzen 9 5900X?
tasks.implementation: Fresh clone of the branch, CARGO_TARGET_DIR per worktree, rust-toolchain.toml honoured. Run the commands below; then the ignored measurement test three times with nothing else running.
acceptance: cargo test --locked -p vigilode --features structured --release --no-fail-fast: 0 failed
cargo test --locked -p rodas5p-integrators --release --lib --test stage_clients_banded_two_way --test stage_clients_banded_tight_identity: 0 failed
python3 -I research/stage_lattice_referee_20261124/verify.py exits 0
three timing JSONL files under owner_host/ with host description, load and spread
tasks.kill: none (reproduction task); record any mismatch as a finding
tasks.fallback: keep this run's numbers labelled diagnostic

tasks.title: Owner decision: promote the same-bits tight kernel to the default banded route for half widths below 6
tasks.question: Tight (BandedTightStageLu) returns the protected banded driver's bits (V21 stage b, this run's facade tests). Should the facade's banded route use it where it currently runs the Indexed kernel?
tasks.implementation: Route Plan::Banded with min(lower, upper) < BANDED_SLICES_MIN_HALF_WIDTH to the client driver with BandedTightStageLu; keep the entry-point and driver identifiers of the record honest (new identifiers, documented); the band operation counters of DriverWork::Banded are not produced by the client, so either extend the client to count them or record their absence explicitly.
acceptance: default_path_golden: 0 changed values (the record identifiers are the only allowed difference and must be listed)
stage_clients_banded_tight_identity: 16 of 16 identity cells bit-identical
owner-host preregistered whole-solve cells: instructions <= 0.60 and cycles <= 0.80 of the Indexed route at n >= 1e4
tasks.kill: any changed state bit or counter in the golden files
commands: cargo test --locked -p vigilode --release --test default_path_golden --test banded_stage_policy --test banded_kernel_route_contracts

tasks.title: Two-way client: fixed-offset kernel for l = u = 2, persistent pool, preregistered owner-host measurement
tasks.question: Does the two-way client beat the same-bits tight kernel on whole solves once each front runs the tight kernel's fixed-offset loops and the pool is reused across solves?
tasks.implementation: Write the two fronts' factor/forward/backward with the carried-value loops of BandedTightStageLu::factor_fixed2/solve_fixed2 (the bottom front in reversed orientation); keep the general loops for other bands. Add a pool owned by the client (or a caller-provided rayon::ThreadPool through BandedStagePolicy) so a solve does not build a pool. Preregister cells: 1D Brusselator n in {2e4, 2e5, 2e6}, 2D Allen-Cahn bands 32/64/128, rtol 1e-6 and 1e-8; arms tight, two-way serial, two-way join.
acceptance: fixed-offset two-way equals general two-way bit for bit on every unit and whole-IVP case
serial equals join bit for bit
whole-solve cycles of two-way join <= 0.80 of tight on every authoritative cell with n >= 2e5 or band >= 64
tasks.kill: two-way join >= 0.95 of tight on every authoritative cell
tasks.fallback: keep BandedStagePolicy::TwoWay opt-in with the measured scope; record the negative

tasks.title: Stage wavefront driver: alternating LU/UL orientation with a row-streaming RHS
tasks.question: Can the 9n lattice depth of THEORY.md SL-1 be realised on a real banded problem with a row-local RHS, and does it beat two-way at two workers or combine with it at four?
tasks.implementation: Research driver only. New callback contract RowRhsFn(t, y, rows, out) with declared stencil half width w; odd stages factored LU, even stages UL (one factorisation of W and one of its flip per attempt, both from the same W), stage i+1 streams behind stage i in row blocks guarded by per-block completion counters. First build the serial alternating-orientation driver and prove the pipelined one equals it bit for bit.
acceptance: pipelined driver equals the serial alternating driver bit for bit (states, attempts, counters)
alternating serial driver agrees with the protected driver within 1e-2 tolerance units on the SL test problems
measured critical-path proxy (row blocks on the longest chain) matches stage_lattice_dag.py within 5%
tasks.kill: pipelined wall >= two-way join wall on every owner-host cell
tasks.fallback: keep SL-1 as a theory result; no driver change

tasks.title: SPIKE-P stage client with residual verification and two-way fallback
tasks.question: With P = 4, 8 blocks, restricted pivoting and a per-solve residual check (V19 arm CV), how often does the check fail, and does the verified client beat two-way at P >= 4 cores?
tasks.implementation: Port V19 arms C(P)/CV(P) from research/production_loop_20261116/banded_solve/runner into a StageLinearSystem client; on a failed residual check or a block pivot error re-factor with the two-way client in the same attempt and charge both.
acceptance: V19 suites S1-S5: no silent failure (eta > 1e-12 without error)
fallback counts reported per suite
owner host: verified SPIKE-8 <= 0.6 of two-way join per stage pattern at n >= 2e5
tasks.kill: fallback in more than 10% of the stage patterns of any IVP of the SL suite

tasks.title: Exact separable stage solver on S^2 (DFT in longitude, two-way tridiagonal per mode)
tasks.question: For DiffusionGrid::sphere with a ring-constant diagonal reaction, W = I/(h gamma) - J is block-diagonalised by the DFT in longitude; is the mode-parallel exact solve faster than P1 GMRES with the longitude preconditioner at matched achieved error?
tasks.implementation: Owner decision: add an FFT dependency or write an internal radix-2 + Bluestein FFT. Implement the per-mode tridiagonal systems from the Ring coefficients (north, south, azimuth, area), solve each with the two-way tridiagonal elimination, modes in parallel; expose as a stage policy of the matrix-free sphere route that verifies the original unpreconditioned residual and falls back to P1 GMRES when the Jacobian is not ring-constant.
acceptance: relative residual of the original W <= 1e-12 on every stage
constant null mode and area mass preserved to round-off
whole IVP error against the sparse expm reference of research/spatial_review_20261124 within the recorded envelope
cost per accepted step below P1 + longitude preconditioner at matched error on 32x64 and 64x128
tasks.kill: slower than P1 + preconditioner on every cell

tasks.title: Package consolidation: research gates out of the production build
tasks.question: Can the 35 research-gate modules (28,636 lines; results/INTEGRATOR_INVENTORY.json) leave the default build without changing any facade result?
tasks.implementation: Owner decision between a cargo feature `research-gates` (smallest change) and a new crate `vigilode-research`. Gate every module with status research-gate behind it; tests and examples that need them get required-features. The facade must not need the feature.
acceptance: cargo build -p vigilode without the feature succeeds
default_path_golden byte-identical; facade suite unchanged
every existing test target still runs with --features research-gates
compile time and compiled line count of the default build reported before and after
tasks.kill: a facade route needs a research-gate module
tasks.fallback: reclassify that module in the inventory and keep it in the default build

SolveSpec { method: Auto | Rodas5p | Registry(id), stages: StagePolicy, structure: None | Modal(...) | Cubic(...), fallback }. Every combination maps to exactly one existing entry point.

every refusal happens before any callback (counting callbacks)
VigilODE::solve and Rodas5p::solve unchanged (golden)
